mapper.select: SELECT "cd"."operation_cancel_date" FROM "calendar_cancel_dates" "cd" JOIN "calendars" "c" ON "c"."del_flag" = 0 AND "c"."available_flag" = 1 AND "c"."business_corp_id" = #{businessCorpId} AND "c"."calendar_id" = "cd"."calendar_id" WHERE "cd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "cd"."operation_cancel_date" > CURRENT_DATE AND "cd"."calendar_id" = #{calendarId}
SELECT "calendar_cancel_date_id" , to_char("operation_cancel_date", 'YYMMDD') AS "operation_cancel_date" FROM "calendar_cancel_dates" WHERE "del_flag" = 0 AND "calendar_id" = #{calendarId}

SELECT TO_CHAR("ccd"."operation_cancel_date", 'YYYYMMDD') AS "operationCancelDate" FROM "calendar_cancel_dates" AS "ccd" WHERE "ccd"."del_flag" = 0 AND "ccd"."calendar_id" = #{calendarId, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY "ccd"."operation_cancel_date" ASC
